comment: Live O38 findings the checker cannot fix in story files. Each entry is one finding: exact code and at, reason at least 40 characters, no wildcards. A reason says the data is not fixed. Categories with no live hit (reused-name, reused-wanderer-id, ungated-pack-item, unknown-trait, prefab-gather) stay enforced and are not listed here.
